title: feat(app-shell): marketplace card and package page show which languages an app ships
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYH6pirAR8NaHkLvUrUr9cq)_

Part of #31462. The card, detail and null faces land here; the languages facet follows in its own PR once the cloud lane names where the list answer carries the `languages` counts (asked on the card, unanswered at this head).
Part of #30284 (the console half; the cloud half is cloud#3803, live on staging).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:应用市场卡片显示该应用最新版本支持的语言和翻译覆盖率(如「简体中文 100% · 日本語 60%」,最多三个,其余显示「+N more」),详情页在分类标签栏列出全部语言并标出默认语言;旧版本(未测量)显示「无语言信息」。
- **为什么改**:客户选应用时看不出它有没有中文等语言、翻译了多少;cloud#3803 已在发布时测量并下发这两个字段,控制台这一半负责显示。
- **风险与回滚**:只读显示,不改数据和接口;接口没返回这两个字段(生产环境目前就是这样)时页面和现在完全一样。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/shippedLanguages.ts`(三种回答的判定)、`MarketplaceLanguages.tsx`(卡片行与详情组)、`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/en.ts`(新增 4 个键)。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx`,预期 25 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`marketplaceApi.ts`** types the two keys cloud#3803 serves on every version: `supported_locales: string[] | null` (the locales that carry text, default first, as the app declares them) and `locale_coverage: { default_locale, expected_keys, locales: [{ locale, translated, coverage_percent }] } | null`. Both optional: a catalog that does not serve them yet still type-checks and reads as absent.
- **`shippedLanguages.ts`** (new) reads a version into one of three answers, kept apart on purpose:
  - keys absent: `unserved`, nothing drawn, so the CONTROL catalog renders exactly as before;
  - `supported_locales: null`: `unknown`, "No language information", never "English only";
  - a list: each locale in served order with its served `coverage_percent` (a locale the coverage has no row for is drawn without a percent), the first marked default.
  Names follow #30514's reading, with no second map: `localeLabel(resolveBuiltInLanguage(code) ?? code)`, so `zh-CN` reads 简体中文 as in the language menu and `th`, outside the platform table, reads ไทย. Percents are formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat` in `useDisplayLocale()`, so no pack carries a format string.
- **`MarketplaceLanguages.tsx`** (new): the card's line (three languages, then `+N more`; the full list in the tooltip and the screen-reader text) and the package page's "Languages" group in the taxonomy strip (every language, the default marked, the served code as each badge's title).
- **`MarketplacePage.tsx` / `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`** mount them: the card under its description, the detail group after the taxonomy groups, reading the version the page already calls latest.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: four keys in each of the eleven marketplace catalogues (`namespaces/marketplace/*.ts`, `zh-Hant` regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`): `marketplace.facet.languages`, `marketplace.languages.none`, `marketplace.languages.more` (placeholder `extra`), `marketplace.languages.default`. They are published through the `./locales` entry (`en: typeof enPack & typeof enMarketplace`), hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

## Tests

New `describe` blocks in the existing harness files (each case drives the rendered page through a stubbed `fetch` that answers the proxy's body):

- `MarketplacePage.facets-31011.test.tsx` · "Marketplace card languages": a measured version shows `English 100% · 简体中文 100% · 日本語 60% · +1 more` with `ไทย 12.5%` in the tooltip and screen-reader text, and a locale without a coverage row draws without a percent; a `null` version reads "No language information" and not "English"; CONTROL, a catalog without the keys draws no line.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.taxonomy-31011.test.tsx` · "Details — the languages an app ships": the full list in served order with the default marked; the `null` face; CONTROL, no group.

The de quote-pairing, count-family, untranslated-identity, machine-locale and namespace censuses are in that run.
- The two touched harness files plus `ui/scripts/__tests__/percent-storage-callers-11475.test.ts` after the last source commit: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 38 passed (38)`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 5027 passed`.
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 70/70 tasks, both `type-check` tasks executed (cache miss).
- `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`: exit 0 (no designer en value changed); `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob c87a3e41)</summary>

- `if (served === null) return UNKNOWN;` → `return UNSERVED`: exactly the two null-face cases go red (`2 failed | 23 passed`).
- `if (!Array.isArray(served)) return UNSERVED;` → `return UNKNOWN`: exactly the two CONTROL cases go red (`2 failed | 23 passed`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live verification NOT MEASURED: staging is unreachable from this container** (the egress proxy answers 403 to CONNECT for the cloud hosts), and the cloud repository is not readable from this lane, so the served shape is the card's statement and there are no live screenshots. Production does not serve the keys yet (cloud seat reading on the card); there the page reads exactly as today.
- **The languages facet is not in this PR.** Its values can only come from the served counts, and the card does not say where the list answer carries them (`data.facets.languages`, `data.languages`, a record keyed by tag…). The question is on the card for the cloud lane; the facet follows in its own PR once answered, never on a guessed shape.
- **#31834**: on the public snapshot path (`OS_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` set) the runtime's marketplace proxy filters and pages the catalog itself and does not read `?languages=`, so a languages filter would answer the unfiltered catalog. It is filed separately (`packages/cloud-connection`, outside this card's surface); the default path, which forwards the query to the cloud unchanged, is the one this card builds on.
- The spec's `MarketplaceSearchRequestSchema` / `MarketplaceSearchResponseSchema` declare no `languages`; the cloud list door does not answer that schema today either. Noted, not changed here (no `packages/spec` in the claim).

## Verification

- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 39 commands): all run locally, exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). 34 re-ran at head 6351a1aa; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` and `pnpm check:type-check-debt` ran at the last branch commit before the merge of main, which brought no ui or spec change; the three PR-body gates and `check-partof-closing-keyword` ran against this body.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and its `--self-test`: exit 0.
